review_markdown.description: The full code review in markdown format

inline_comments.description: Inline comments anchored to specific diff lines. Only include when confident the line is in the diff.

issue_id.description: Must match an id in state.open_issues

file.description: Exact file path as it appears in the diff

line.description: End line number in the new file version

start_line.description: Required key. Start line for a multi-line range (must be < line), or null for single-line comments.

body.description: Detailed explanation for the inline comment

suggestion.description: Required key. Replacement code for a GitHub suggestion block, or null when no suggestion is available.

state.description: Machine-readable state for review continuity across runs

pr_summary.description: Brief summary of the PR for context in future reviews

open_issues.description: Open findings, ordered by reachable user impact. CI derives the merge gate from these entries, not from the verdict word in review_markdown.

reachability.description: How the failure is reached today. normal_path: ordinary use hits it. compound_path: every trigger in the chain must align. theoretical: no supported execution path in the merged code reaches it.

likelihood.description: How often the reachability chain is expected to occur in current production use.

worst_credible_consequence.description: Worst outcome supported by current evidence, not a merely conceivable one.

recoverability.description: routine: retry, rerun, or ordinary manual correction. painful: coordinated operational recovery. irreversible: data or external effects cannot be undone.

area.description: Code | Docs | Performance | Security | Rollout | Cleanup

notes.description: Additional context or evidence for the issue

review_dispositions.description: Trusted maintainer/author dispositions from inline review threads, top-level PR comments, or top-level PR review summaries that affect whether previous review findings should be treated as fixed, intentionally unchanged, or deferred.
